description: This PHP source file defines the LanguageAPI class within the OrangeHRM Admin API module. It provides RESTful endpoints for managing Language entities, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing languages with validation and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: LanguageAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing Language entities, including CRUD operations and list retrieval with validation and API documentation.

methods.name: getLanguageService

methods.description: Retrieves a single Language record by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Language records with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.description: Creates a new Language record with the provided data.

methods.description: Saves the Language entity with data extracted from request parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Language record identified by ID.

methods.description: Generates validation rule for the 'name' parameter, ensuring uniqueness and length constraints.

methods.description: Deletes Language records based on provided IDs.
